intro.zh: 商户与员工 · 选一个任务，按步骤办理。
intro.en: For merchants and staff. Choose a task and follow its steps.

keyRule.zh: 先核对实物，再完成办理。门店提交取酒、扫码核销都会扣库存；顾客生成取酒码不会扣库存。
keyRule.en: Verify the physical bottles first. Staff pickup submission and code redemption deduct stock; generating a customer code does not.

hint.zh: 门店已收到实物时使用。
hint.en: Use when the store has physically received the bottles.

text.zh: 进入“存酒 → 直接登记”，查找并选定顾客；没有档案时，由有权限的管理员新增。
text.en: Open Deposit → Register. Find and select the customer. An authorized administrator can create a missing customer.

text.zh: 选择已有酒品；找不到时按权限新增酒品。填写实际瓶数、整瓶/已开瓶、来源及保存规则，可再加多款酒。
text.en: Select or register the wine as permitted. Enter the actual quantity, whole/opened state, source and storage rule. Add more wines if needed.

text.zh: 照片、位置、仓位、标签和保管人按需填写；有照片可供顾客及员工放大核对。
text.en: Photos, location, slot, label and custodian are optional. Customers and staff can enlarge stored photos.

text.zh: 核对本次款数与瓶数，填写核实说明，勾选已告知规则并收到实物，再点“确认实物已收存”。
text.en: Check wines and bottle totals, enter a verification note and confirm consent and physical receipt. Then select Confirm bottles received.

hint.zh: 顾客已提交申请时使用，避免重复登记。
hint.en: Use for a request already submitted by the customer; do not register it again.

text.zh: 进入“存酒 → 待审核”，选择申请，无需先查找顾客。
text.en: Go to Deposit → Pending and choose the request. No customer search is needed.

text.zh: 对照原申请核对酒品、实际瓶数和瓶身状态；有差异按实填写，并说明原因。
text.en: Compare the original request with the actual wines, quantities and bottle condition. Record differences and explain why.

text.zh: 实物已收到再确认收存；不能接收时填写原因后拒绝申请。
text.en: Confirm receipt only after receiving the bottles. If the request cannot be accepted, reject it with a reason.

hint.zh: 商户、员工确认交付；提交会立即扣减存酒。
hint.en: For staff-confirmed handover. Submitting immediately deducts stored bottles.

text.zh: 进入“取酒”，查找并选定顾客。核对酒名、位置、标签和余量；点击照片可放大。
text.en: Open Collect and select the customer. Check wine, location, label and balance; enlarge photos when available.

text.zh: 用减号、数量、加号设置本次取酒瓶数，可选多款；数量为0表示不取。
text.en: Set quantities using minus, quantity or plus. Select multiple holdings; zero means not selected.

text.zh: 点击“查看取酒车”，核对整车酒品与总瓶数；可移除酒品或返回继续选择。
text.en: Open View pickup cart. Check every holding and the total bottles. Remove a holding or return to select more.

text.zh: 确认整车实物已交付，再点“提交取酒”。成功后一次扣减整车库存，不需要顾客再次扫码。
text.en: After physically handing over the entire cart, select Submit pickup. The full cart is deducted once; no further customer scan is required.

hint.zh: 适用于“快捷存取”模式下的顾客取酒码。
hint.en: For customer pickup codes in Quick storage / collection mode.

text.zh: 顾客进入“取酒”，选择酒品与数量，在取酒车提交后生成一个整车取酒码；此时尚未扣库存。
text.en: The customer selects wines and quantities and submits the pickup cart to generate one code. Stock is not deducted yet.

text.zh: 当面核对顾客、酒品、瓶数及位置，确认交付对象与整车明细一致。
text.en: Verify the customer, bottles, quantities and locations in person against the full cart.

text.zh: 门店进入“取酒 → 扫描顾客取酒码并核销”。扫描成功即完成整车核销并扣库存，按码内数量交付。
text.en: Open Collect → Scan and redeem customer code. A successful scan completes redemption and deducts the entire cart; hand over the quantities in the code.

text.zh: 过期、已取消或已使用的码不能再领；未完成的取酒码不会扣库存，需要时请顾客重新生成。
text.en: Expired, cancelled or already-used codes cannot be redeemed. Uncompleted codes do not deduct stock; ask the customer to create a new code if needed.

hint.zh: 看现余用“当前寄存”；查已办理业务用“报表”。
hint.en: Use Stock for current balances and Reports for historical business records.

text.zh: 进入“当前寄存”，按顾客、酒品或位置查询余量与到期情况；需要时导出Excel。
text.en: Open Stock to find balances and expiry by customer, wine or location. Export Excel when needed.

text.zh: 进入“报表”，选择存酒或取酒，按关键词、状态、起止日期筛选，再点“查询”。无需新增或选择顾客。
text.en: Open Reports. Choose Deposits or Pickups, set keyword, status and date filters, then Search. No customer creation or selection is needed.

text.zh: 一笔业务一行，每页20笔；汇总覆盖全部筛选结果。实收/实取只统计完成单，不代表当前库存。点“详情”查看原申请、照片及日志。
text.en: One bill per row, 20 per page; totals cover all matches. Received/collected bottles count completed bills, not current stock. Details retain requests, photos and audit evidence.

hint.zh: 入口和可修改项目以开通情况及岗位权限为准。
hint.en: Available entries and editable settings depend on product access and role permissions.

text.zh: 进入“设置”，按权限维护寄存酒商品、常用位置、保管人与保存规则；员工看不到可修改项时请联系管理员。
text.en: In Settings, maintain wines, locations, custodians and storage rules as permitted. Staff without edit access should contact an administrator.

text.zh: “快捷存取”支持顾客申请与出码，也支持门店直接办理；“租户直接登记”由门店办理，顾客查看记录。
text.en: Quick mode supports customer requests/codes and direct staff handling. Staff registration mode is handled by the store; customers view records.

text.zh: 从设置里的顾客入口，或后台“常用入口与二维码”获取顾客存酒链接/二维码，先核对门店再分享。
text.en: Get the customer storage link/code from Settings or Common entries and QR codes. Verify the store before sharing.

text.zh: 看到“上次操作结果不确定”时，先检查/恢复上次操作，不要反复提交。
text.en: If a previous result is uncertain, check or recover it before submitting again.

title.zh: 看不到入口或不能提交

text.zh: 先刷新并检查当前门店、产品开通及员工权限。业务关闭后历史保留；历史页只供查询，存取以页面允许的操作为准。
text.en: Refresh and check the store, product access and staff permissions. History remains after closure; historical pages are read-only. Follow the operations currently allowed on screen.

text.zh: 新规则用于之后收存；已有酒品保留原快照。取酒数量或状态变化时，重新核对取酒车后提交。
text.en: New rules apply to later receipts; existing holdings keep their snapshots. If balances or eligibility change, review the cart again.
